Predict match probabilities from a Dixon-Coles model

Source: R/models_dc.R
predict_dc.Rd

Uses goalmodel::predict_result() for 1X2 probabilities and goalmodel::predict_goals() for expected goals, then builds a score matrix for O/U and AH markets.

Usage

predict_dc(model, home_team, away_team, max_goals = 7L)

Arguments

model

A goalmodel object from fit_dixon_coles().

home_team

Character. Home team name.

away_team

Character. Away team name.

max_goals

Integer. Maximum goals for score matrix (default 7).

Value

A list with probs_1x2, probs_ou25, probs_ah05, lambda_home, lambda_away.
